maddeler.e:
نشمئز (form IVq)
# نَشْمَئِزُّ (našmaʔizzu) /naʃ.ma.ʔiz.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# نَشْمَئِزَّ (našmaʔizza) /naʃ.ma.ʔiz.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# نَشْمَئِزِّ (našmaʔizzi) /naʃ.ma.ʔiz.zi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
